name: Open Box Deal – Resell returned products and B-stock
author: Slashdown

sections.description:
Resell returned, open-box and B-stock products directly in WooCommerce.
Manage returns, recover lost revenue and reduce waste with this free plugin.
Check out the demo →

Video includes premium functionality as well: Learn more →

With this plugin you can easily:
* Create dedicated “Open Box Deal” products linked to the original item.
* Add product photos of the returned item.
* Offer a lower price to attract buyers while recovering lost revenue.
* Keep your main catalog clean: Open Box Deals don’t clutter your shop loops.

This plugin is perfect for stores that want to reduce waste, improve sustainability, and maximize profit from B-stock or second chance products.

Free vs Pro (Premium) Features

Free version: Create Open Box Deals for simple products.
Premium: Adds support for variable products, condition templates, visibility control, advanced settings and priority support.
Learn more →

Create Open Box Deal

  1. In your WordPress Admin, go to Products > Add New Product.
  2. Enter the Product name of your Open Box Deal product. This will be displayed on the product page and in the order summary.
  3. Scroll down to the Product data section and ensure that Simple product is selected from the dropdown menu.
  4. Click on the Linked Products tab within the Product data section.
  5. Click on the dropdown under Open Box Deal Main Product and search for the product you want to link this Open Box Deal product to.
    Optionally, add a product image specifically for the Open Box Deal. If no image is selected, the default image from the main product will be used.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/open-box-deal, or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Can I use this plugin for all types of WooCommerce products?

The free version only works with simple products. Variable products are available in Open Box Deal Premium.

Is there a limit in the free version?

There is no limit, you can create as many Open Box Deals as you need.

Does it change my original product data?

No. Open Box Deal creates linked “deal products.” Your main product stays untouched. Only a subtle link to the Open Box Deal will be added.

Is it compatible with caching or SEO plugins like Yoast?

Yes, Open Box Deal follows standard WooCommerce product handling, so it works with most caching and SEO plugins.

Is there a premium version?

Yes. Open Box Deal Premium is available on WooCommerce.com and adds product variations, condition templates and advanced settings.
Learn more →
